summary: Muthappa Rai was a prominent Indian underworld figure from Karnataka who later transitioned into a businessman, philanthropist, and social activist. He wielded significant influence in Bengaluru and Mangaluru before passing away from cancer in 2020.

facts.fact: Muthappa Rai started his career as a bank clerk in Syndicate Bank before entering the underworld.
He was associated with high-profile underworld activities in Bengaluru and Mumbai during the 1980s and 1990s.
He founded an NGO named 'REACH' aimed at social service and philanthropy in his later years.
He survived an assassination attempt inside a court premises in Bengaluru in 2002.
He passed away due to brain cancer at a hospital in Bengaluru in May 2020.

claims.claim: Rai was closely linked to international underworld operations and spent time exiled in Dubai.
He claimed to have reformed completely and left his criminal past behind after returning to India in the 2010s.
Law enforcement agencies suspected him of orchestrating several high-profile contract killings during the peak of his underworld career.
